# Video Speed Shortcuts 0.3.0

### New features

- Added batch editing for site rules, making it possible to update multiple sites at once.

### Improvements

- Target speed can now be set above the maximum used by increase and decrease shortcuts.
- Improved support for video players nested inside Shadow DOM.
- Added direct Chrome, Edge, and Firefox installation links to the project documentation.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/chenghsj/video-speed-shortcuts/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0
